note: Schema classes and properties read from each release's generatedSchema.usda files.

schemas.name: APISchemaBase
schemas.doc: The base class for all API schemas.

schemas.name: ClipsAPI
schemas.doc: UsdClipsAPI is an API schema that provides an interface to a prim's clip metadata.

schemas.name: CollectionAPI
schemas.doc: A general purpose API schema used to describe a collection of prims and properties within a scene.

schemas.name: ColorSpaceAPI
schemas.doc: UsdColorSpaceAPI is an API schema that introduces a `colorSpace` property for authoring scene referred color space opinions.

schemas.name: ColorSpaceDefinitionAPI
schemas.doc: UsdColorSpaceDefinitionAPI is an API schema for defining a custom color space.

schemas.name: ModelAPI
schemas.doc: UsdModelAPI is an API schema that provides an interface to a prim's model qualities, if it does, in fact, represent the root prim of a model.

schemas.name: Typed
schemas.doc: The base class for all typed schemas (those that can impart a typeName to a UsdPrim), and therefore the base class for all concrete, instantiable "IsA" schemas.

schemas.name: BasisCurves
schemas.doc: BasisCurves are a batched curve representation analogous to the classic RIB definition via Basis and Curves statements.

schemas.name: Camera
schemas.doc: Transformable camera.

schemas.name: Capsule
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive capsule, i.e. a cylinder capped by two half spheres, centered at the origin, whose spine is along the specified axis.

schemas.name: Capsule_1
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive capsule, i.e. a cylinder capped by two half spheres, with potentially different radii, centered at the origin, and whose spine is along the specified axis.

schemas.name: Cone
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive cone, centered at the origin, whose spine is along the specified axis, with the apex of the cone pointing in the direction of the positive axis.

schemas.name: Cube
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive rectilinear cube centered at the origin.

schemas.name: Cylinder
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive cylinder with closed ends, centered at the origin, whose spine is along the specified axis.

schemas.name: Cylinder_1
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive cylinder with closed ends, centered at the origin, whose spine is along the specified axis, with a pair of radii describing the size of the end points.

schemas.name: GeomSubset
schemas.doc: Encodes a subset of a piece of geometry (i.e. a UsdGeomImageable) as a set of indices.

schemas.name: HermiteCurves
schemas.doc: This schema specifies a cubic hermite interpolated curve batch as sometimes used for defining guides for animation.

schemas.name: Mesh
schemas.doc: Encodes a mesh with optional subdivision properties and features.

schemas.name: NurbsCurves
schemas.doc: This schema is analagous to NURBS Curves in packages like Maya and Houdini, often used for interchange of rigging and modeling curves.

schemas.name: NurbsPatch
schemas.doc: Encodes a rational or polynomial non-uniform B-spline surface, with optional trim curves.

schemas.name: Plane
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive plane, centered at the origin, and is defined by a cardinal axis, width, and length.

schemas.name: PointInstancer
schemas.doc: Encodes vectorized instancing of multiple, potentially animated, prototypes (object/instance masters), which can be arbitrary prims/subtrees on a UsdStage.

schemas.name: Points
schemas.doc: Points are analogous to the RiPoints spec.

schemas.name: Scope
schemas.doc: Scope is the simplest grouping primitive, and does not carry the baggage of transformability.

schemas.name: Sphere
schemas.doc: Defines a primitive sphere centered at the origin.

schemas.name: TetMesh
schemas.doc: Encodes a tetrahedral mesh.

schemas.name: Xform
schemas.doc: Concrete prim schema for a transform, which implements Xformable

schemas.name: BackPlateAPI
schemas.doc: This schema specifies a back plate i.e. a camera-constrained but not always camera-facing texture card, that exists in scene space.

schemas.name: Boundable
schemas.doc: Boundable introduces the ability for a prim to persistently cache a rectilinear, local-space, extent.

schemas.name: Curves
schemas.doc: Base class for UsdGeomBasisCurves, UsdGeomNurbsCurves, and UsdGeomHermiteCurves.

schemas.name: GeomModelAPI
schemas.doc: Name of the attribute used to author extents hints at the root of leaf models.

schemas.name: Gprim
schemas.doc: Base class for all geometric primitives.

schemas.name: Imageable
schemas.doc: Base class for all prims that may require rendering or visualization of some sort.

schemas.name: MotionAPI
schemas.doc: UsdGeomMotionAPI encodes data that can live on any prim that may affect computations involving: - computed motion for motion blur - sampling for motion blur The GetMotionBlurScaleAttr() "motion:blurScale" attribute allows artists to scal…

schemas.name: PointBased
schemas.doc: Base class for all UsdGeomGprims that possess points, providing common attributes such as normals and velocities.

schemas.name: PrimvarsAPI
schemas.doc: UsdGeomPrimvarsAPI encodes geometric "primitive variables", as UsdGeomPrimvar, which interpolate across a primitive's topology, can override shader inputs, and inherit down namespace.

schemas.name: VisibilityAPI
schemas.doc: UsdGeomVisibilityAPI introduces properties that can be used to author visibility opinions.

schemas.name: XformCommonAPI
schemas.doc: This class provides API for authoring and retrieving a standard set of component transformations which include a scale, a rotation, a scale-rotate pivot and a translation.

schemas.name: Xformable
schemas.doc: Base class for all transformable prims, which allows arbitrary sequences of component affine transformations to be encoded.

schemas.name: Look
schemas.doc: deprecated Deprecated in favor of Material.

schemas.name: Material
schemas.doc: A Material provides a container into which multiple "render contexts" can add data that defines a "shading material" for a renderer.

schemas.name: NodeGraph
schemas.doc: A node-graph is a container for shading nodes, as well as other node-graphs.

schemas.name: Shader
schemas.doc: Base class for all USD shaders.

schemas.name: Subgraph
schemas.doc: A subgraph is a container for shading nodes, as well as other subgraphs.

schemas.name: ConnectableAPI
schemas.doc: UsdShadeConnectableAPI is an API schema that provides a common interface for creating outputs and making connections between shading parameters and outputs.

schemas.name: CoordSysAPI
schemas.doc: UsdShadeCoordSysAPI provides a way to designate, name, and discover coordinate systems.

schemas.name: MaterialBindingAPI
schemas.doc: UsdShadeMaterialBindingAPI is an API schema that provides an interface for binding materials to prims or collections of prims (represented by UsdCollectionAPI objects).

schemas.name: NodeDefAPI
schemas.doc: UsdShadeNodeDefAPI is an API schema that provides attributes for a prim to select a corresponding Shader Node Definition ("Sdr Node"), as well as to look up a runtime entry for that shader node in the form of an SdrShaderNode.

schemas.name: CylinderLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted outward from a cylinder.

schemas.name: DiskLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted from one side of a circular disk.

schemas.name: DistantLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted from a distant source along the -Z axis.

schemas.name: DomeLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted inward from a distant external environment, such as a sky or IBL light probe.

schemas.name: DomeLight_1
schemas.doc: Light emitted inward from a distant external environment, such as a sky or IBL light probe.

schemas.name: GeometryLight
schemas.doc: deprecated Light emitted outward from a geometric prim (UsdGeomGprim), which is typically a mesh.

schemas.name: LightFilter
schemas.doc: A light filter modifies the effect of a light.

schemas.name: LightPortal
schemas.doc: deprecated This remains for backward compatability for now but is identical to PortalLight which should be used instead.

schemas.name: PluginLight
schemas.doc: Light that provides properties that allow it to identify an external SdrShadingNode definition, through UsdShadeNodeDefAPI, that can be provided to render delegates without the need to provide a schema definition for the light's type.

schemas.name: PluginLightFilter
schemas.doc: Light filter that provides properties that allow it to identify an external SdrShadingNode definition, through UsdShadeNodeDefAPI, that can be provided to render delegates without the need to provide a schema definition for the light fil…

schemas.name: PortalLight
schemas.doc: A rectangular portal in the local XY plane that guides sampling of a dome light.

schemas.name: RectLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted from one side of a rectangle.

schemas.name: SphereLight
schemas.doc: Light emitted outward from a sphere.

schemas.name: BoundableLightBase
schemas.doc: Base class for intrinsic lights that are boundable.

schemas.name: Light
schemas.doc: Base class for all lights.

schemas.name: LightAPI
schemas.doc: API schema that imparts the quality of being a light onto a prim.

schemas.name: LightListAPI
schemas.doc: API schema to support discovery and publishing of lights in a scene.

schemas.name: ListAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated Use LightListAPI instead

schemas.name: MeshLightAPI
schemas.doc: This is the preferred API schema to apply to UsdGeomMesh "Mesh" type prims when adding light behaviors to a mesh.

schemas.name: NonboundableLightBase
schemas.doc: Base class for intrinsic lights that are not boundable.

schemas.name: ShadowAPI
schemas.doc: Controls to refine a light's shadow behavior.

schemas.name: ShapingAPI
schemas.doc: Controls for shaping a light's emission.

schemas.name: VolumeLightAPI
schemas.doc: This is the preferred API schema to apply to UsdVolVolume "Volume" type prims when adding light behaviors to a volume.

schemas.name: BlendShape
schemas.doc: Describes a target blend shape, possibly containing inbetween shapes.

schemas.name: Joint
schemas.doc: Describes a skeleton joint.

schemas.name: PackedJointAnimation
schemas.doc: Deprecated.

schemas.name: SkelAnimation
schemas.doc: Describes a skel animation, where joint animation is stored in a vectorized form.

schemas.name: SkelRoot
schemas.doc: Boundable prim type used to identify a scope beneath which skeletally-posed primitives are defined.

schemas.name: Skeleton
schemas.doc: Describes a skeleton.

schemas.name: BindingAPI
schemas.doc: Provides API for authoring and extracting all the skinning-related data that lives in the "geometry hierarchy" of prims and models that want to be skeletally deformed.

schemas.name: SkelBindingAPI
schemas.doc: Provides API for authoring and extracting all the skinning-related data that lives in the "geometry hierarchy" of prims and models that want to be skeletally deformed.

schemas.name: Field3DAsset
schemas.doc: Field3D field primitive.

schemas.name: OpenVDBAsset
schemas.doc: OpenVDB field primitive.

schemas.name: ParticleField
schemas.doc: A ParticleField prim is used as a base to describe different types of concrete ParticleField implementations, such as, but not limited to, 3D Gaussian Splats.

schemas.name: ParticleField3DGaussianSplat
schemas.doc: This is a concrete ParticleField representing the original 3D Gaussian Splats technique (https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.04079).

schemas.name: Volume
schemas.doc: A renderable volume primitive.

schemas.name: FieldAsset
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be removed in a future release.

schemas.name: FieldBase
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be removed in a future release.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldKernelBaseAPI
schemas.doc: Defines a base-class type applied schema that all applied schema that provide a ParticleField kernel will automatically apply.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldKernelConstantSurfletAPI
schemas.doc: Defines the constant surflet kernel for a given ParticleField.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldKernelGaussianEllipsoidAPI
schemas.doc: Defines the gaussian ellipsoid kernel for a given ParticleField.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldKernelGaussianSurfletAPI
schemas.doc: Defines the gaussian surflet kernel for a given ParticleField.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldOpacityAttributeAPI
schemas.doc: A ParticleField related applied schema that provides an opacities attribute to define the opacity of the particles.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldOrientationAttributeAPI
schemas.doc: A ParticleField related applied schema that provides an orientations attribute to define the orientation of the particles.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldPositionAttributeAPI
schemas.doc: A ParticleField related applied schema that provides a position attribute to define the locations of the particles.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldPositionBaseAPI
schemas.doc: Defines a base-class type applied schema that all applied schema that provide the ParticleField position data will automatically apply.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldRadianceBaseAPI
schemas.doc: Defines a base-class type applied schema that all applied schema that provides a ParticleField radiance definition will automatically apply.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldScaleAttributeAPI
schemas.doc: A ParticleField related applied schema that provides a scales attribute to define the linear scale factor applied to the particles.

schemas.name: ParticleFieldSphericalHarmonicsAttributeAPI
schemas.doc: A ParticleField related applied schema that provides spherical harmonics attributes to define the radiance of the particles.

schemas.name: VolumeFieldAsset
schemas.doc: The base schema class for volume field primitives defined by an external file.

schemas.name: VolumeFieldBase
schemas.doc: Base class for volume field primitives.

schemas.name: PhysicsCollisionGroup
schemas.doc: Defines a collision group for coarse filtering.

schemas.name: PhysicsDistanceJoint
schemas.doc: Predefined distance joint type (Distance between rigid bodies may be limited to given minimum or maximum distance.)

schemas.name: PhysicsFixedJoint
schemas.doc: Predefined fixed joint type (All degrees of freedom are removed.)

schemas.name: PhysicsJoint
schemas.doc: A joint constrains the movement of rigid bodies.

schemas.name: PhysicsPrismaticJoint
schemas.doc: Predefined prismatic joint type (translation along prismatic joint axis is permitted.)

schemas.name: PhysicsRevoluteJoint
schemas.doc: Predefined revolute joint type (rotation along revolute joint axis is permitted.)

schemas.name: PhysicsScene
schemas.doc: General physics simulation properties, required for simulation.

schemas.name: PhysicsSphericalJoint
schemas.doc: Predefined spherical joint type (Removes linear degrees of freedom, cone limit may restrict the motion in a given range.) It allows two limit values, which when equal create a circular, else an elliptic cone limit around the limit axis.

schemas.name: PhysicsArticulationRootAPI
schemas.doc: PhysicsArticulationRootAPI can be applied to a scene graph node, and marks the subtree rooted here for inclusion in one or more reduced coordinate articulations.

schemas.name: PhysicsCollisionAPI
schemas.doc: Applies collision attributes to a UsdGeomXformable prim.

schemas.name: PhysicsDriveAPI
schemas.doc: The PhysicsDriveAPI when applied to any joint primitive will drive the joint towards a given target.

schemas.name: PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI
schemas.doc: API to describe fine-grained filtering.

schemas.name: PhysicsLimitAPI
schemas.doc: The PhysicsLimitAPI can be applied to a PhysicsJoint and will restrict the movement along an axis.

schemas.name: PhysicsMassAPI
schemas.doc: Defines explicit mass properties (mass, density, inertia etc.).

schemas.name: PhysicsMaterialAPI
schemas.doc: Adds simulation material properties to a Material.

schemas.name: PhysicsMeshCollisionAPI
schemas.doc: Attributes to control how a Mesh is made into a collider.

schemas.name: PhysicsRigidBodyAPI
schemas.doc: Applies physics body attributes to any UsdGeomXformable prim and marks that prim to be driven by a simulation.

schemas.name: RenderDenoisePass
schemas.doc: A RenderDenoisePass generates renders via a denoising process.

schemas.name: RenderPass
schemas.doc: A RenderPass prim encapsulates necessary information to generate multi-pass renders.

schemas.name: RenderProduct
schemas.doc: A UsdRenderProduct describes an image or other file-like artifact produced by a render.

schemas.name: RenderSettings
schemas.doc: A UsdRenderSettings prim specifies global settings for a render process, including an enumeration of the RenderProducts that should result, and the UsdGeomImageable purposes that should be rendered.

schemas.name: RenderVar
schemas.doc: A UsdRenderVar describes a custom data variable for a render to produce.

schemas.name: RenderSettingsAPI
schemas.doc: UsdRenderSettingsAPI is a base class for API schemas to encode renderer-specific settings.

schemas.name: RenderSettingsBase
schemas.doc: Abstract base class that defines render settings that can be specified on either a RenderSettings prim or a RenderProduct prim.

schemas.name: SpatialAudio
schemas.doc: The SpatialAudio primitive defines basic properties for encoding playback of an audio file or stream within a USD Stage.

schemas.name: AssetPreviewsAPI
schemas.doc: AssetPreviewsAPI is the interface for authoring and accessing precomputed, lightweight previews of assets.

schemas.name: AuthorshipAPI
schemas.doc: Records who or what authored a prim.

schemas.name: Backdrop
schemas.doc: Provides a 'group-box' for the purpose of node graph organization.

schemas.name: AccessibilityAPI
schemas.doc: This API describes Accessibility information on a Prim that may be surfaced to a given runtime's accessibility frameworks.

schemas.name: NodeGraphNodeAPI
schemas.doc: This api helps storing information about nodes in node graphs.

schemas.name: SceneGraphPrimAPI
schemas.doc: Utility schema for display properties of a prim

schemas.name: PxrAovLight
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrBarnLightFilter
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrCookieLightFilter
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrEnvDayLight
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrIntMultLightFilter
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrRampLightFilter
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: PxrRodLightFilter
schemas.doc: deprecated This schema will be replaced in a future release.

schemas.name: RisBxdf
schemas.doc: deprecated Specialized RIS shader schemas have been deprecated in favor of all shader prims being simple UsdShadeShader.

schemas.name: RisIntegrator
schemas.doc: deprecated RIS integrator settings will be replaced with a new schema in a future release.

schemas.name: RisObject
schemas.doc: deprecated Specialized RIS shader schemas have been deprecated in favor of all shader prims being simple UsdShadeShader.

schemas.name: RisOslPattern
schemas.doc: deprecated Specialized RIS shader schemas have been deprecated in favor of all shader prims being simple UsdShadeShader.

schemas.name: RisPattern
schemas.doc: deprecated Specialized RIS shader schemas have been deprecated in favor of all shader prims being simple UsdShadeShader.

schemas.name: RslShader
schemas.doc: deprecated RSL shaders have been deprecated in RenderMan.

schemas.name: RiLightAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated RenderMan-specific light settings will move to a new schema in a future release.

schemas.name: RiLightFilterAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated RenderMan-specific light filter settings will move to a new schema in a future release.

schemas.name: RiLightPortalAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated RenderMan-specific light portal settings will move to a new schema in a future release.

schemas.name: RiLookAPI
schemas.doc: This API provides the relationships to prman shaders and RIS objects.

schemas.name: RiMaterialAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated Materials should use UsdShadeMaterial instead.

schemas.name: RiRenderPassAPI
schemas.doc: RiRenderPassAPI is an API schema that provides a mechanism to set certain Ri statements on each prim in a collection, for a given RenderPass prim.

schemas.name: RiSplineAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated This API schema will be removed in a future release.

schemas.name: RiTextureAPI
schemas.doc: deprecated This API schema will be removed in a future release.

schemas.name: Statements
schemas.doc: Container namespace schema for all renderman statements

schemas.name: StatementsAPI
schemas.doc: Container namespace schema for all renderman statements.

schemas.name: HydraGenerativeProceduralAPI
schemas.doc: This API extends and configures the core UsdProcGenerativeProcedural schema defined within usdProc for use with hydra generative procedurals as defined within hdGp.

schemas.name: HydraPrimAPI
schemas.doc: Provides Hydra-specific prim settings.

schemas.name: HydraRenderPassAPI
schemas.doc: Provides Hydra-specific properties for UsdRenderPass.

schemas.name: MaterialXConfigAPI
schemas.doc: MaterialXConfigAPI is an API schema that provides an interface for storing information about the MaterialX environment.

schemas.name: GenerativeProcedural
schemas.doc: Represents an abstract generative procedural prim which delivers its input parameters via properties (including relationships) within the "primvars:" namespace.

schemas.name: SemanticsLabelsAPI
schemas.doc: Application of labels for a prim for a taxonomy specified by the schema's instance name.

schemas.name: IrFkController
schemas.doc: A simple invertible controller that computes a forward kinematic transform.

schemas.name: IrJointScope
schemas.doc: A concrete typed schema that represents the joint of an armature-based model.

schemas.name: IrSwitchController
schemas.doc: An invertible controller that can determine which of several rigs are active at a given time, depending on the value of a switch attribute.

schemas.name: IrController
schemas.doc: An abstract schema that represents an invertible controller.

schemas.name: IrXformable
schemas.doc: An abstract schema that provides an animation interface for an animatable coordinate space.

schemas.name: LODDistanceHeuristic
schemas.doc: This LOD heuristic selects LOD children on the basis of distance from the view point to the LOD root.

schemas.name: LODScreenSizeHeuristic
schemas.doc: This LOD heuristic selects LOD children on the basis of the fraction of the viewplane would be covered by the extent.

schemas.name: LODHeuristic
schemas.doc: Name of the LOD domain for heuristics for generic imaging based renderers.

schemas.name: LODOverrideAPI
schemas.doc: API for overriding Level of Detail (LOD) choices.

schemas.name: LODRootAPI
schemas.doc: API for configuring Level of Detail (LOD) facilities on a prim.

schemas.name: ClaimsAPI
schemas.doc: UsdClaimsAPI records a prim's profile compatibility claims and per-capability usage declarations.
